TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKBANKSTB_SELECT_SRC;

(

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKBANKSTB_SELECT_SRC
(

,BANK_CD

,MEMBER_TYPE
,DISPLAY_SEQ
,INTER_INTRA_STATUS
,STATUS
,SECONDARY_FIELD1

,CREATED_BY

,BANK_BIC
,PESONET
,INSTAPAY

	 CC.BANK_ID
	,CC.VERSION
	,CC.BANK_CD

	,CC.MEMBER_TYPE
	,CC.DISPLAY_SEQ
	,CC.INTER_INTRA_STATUS
	,CC.STATUS
	,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD1
	,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD2
	,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD3
	,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD4
	,CC.CREATED_BY
	,CC.UPDATED_BY
	,CC.CREATED_DATE
	,CC.UPDATED_DATE
	,CC.FLAGS
	,CC.BANK_SHORT_NM
	,CC.IS_CC_ISSUER
	,CC.BANK_BIC
	,CC.PESONET
	,CC.INSTAPAY
	,CC.EWALLET
	,CC.EWALLETSEQ
	,CC.QR
	,CC.P2M
	,FILE_NAME
	,0 AS JSRC_FLG

	FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKBANKSTB CC

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKBANKSTB_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKBANKSTB_GROUP_SRC
(
BANK_ID
,VERSION
,BANK_CD
,BANK_NM
,MEMBER_TYPE
,DISPLAY_SEQ
,INTER_INTRA_STATUS
,STATUS
,SECONDARY_FIELD1
,SECONDARY_FIELD2
,SECONDARY_FIELD3
,SECONDARY_FIELD4
,CREATED_BY
,UPDATED_BY
,CREATED_DATE
,UPDATED_DATE
,FLAGS
,BANK_SHORT_NM
,IS_CC_ISSUER
,BANK_BIC
,PESONET
,INSTAPAY
,EWALLET
,EWALLETSEQ
,QR
,P2M
,FILE_NAME
,JSRC_FLG_CNT
,JTAR_FLG_CNT
,FILE_DATE
)

	SELECT 
	BANK_ID
	,VERSION
	,BANK_CD
	,BANK_NM
	,MEMBER_TYPE
	,DISPLAY_SEQ
	,INTER_INTRA_STATUS
	,STATUS
	,SECONDARY_FIELD1
	,SECONDARY_FIELD2
	,SECONDARY_FIELD3
	,SECONDARY_FIELD4
	,CREATED_BY
	,UPDATED_BY
	,CREATED_DATE
	,UPDATED_DATE
	,FLAGS
	,BANK_SHORT_NM
	,IS_CC_ISSUER
	,BANK_BIC
	,PESONET
	,INSTAPAY
	,EWALLET
	,EWALLETSEQ
	,QR
	,P2M
	,FILE_NAME
	,JSRC_FLG_CNT
	,JTAR_FLG_CNT
	,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
	FROM 
		(
		SELECT
		BANK_ID
		,VERSION
		,BANK_CD
		,BANK_NM
		,MEMBER_TYPE
		,DISPLAY_SEQ
		,INTER_INTRA_STATUS
		,STATUS
		,SECONDARY_FIELD1
		,SECONDARY_FIELD2
		,SECONDARY_FIELD3
		,SECONDARY_FIELD4
		,CREATED_BY
		,UPDATED_BY
		,CREATED_DATE
		,UPDATED_DATE
		,FLAGS
		,BANK_SHORT_NM
		,IS_CC_ISSUER
		,BANK_BIC
		,PESONET
		,INSTAPAY
		,EWALLET
		,EWALLETSEQ
		,QR
		,P2M
		,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
		,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT
		,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
		FROM d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKBANKSTB_SELECT_SRC
			GROUP BY 
			BANK_ID
			,VERSION
			,BANK_CD
			,BANK_NM
			,MEMBER_TYPE
			,DISPLAY_SEQ
			,INTER_INTRA_STATUS
			,STATUS
			,SECONDARY_FIELD1
			,SECONDARY_FIELD2
			,SECONDARY_FIELD3
			,SECONDARY_FIELD4
			,CREATED_BY
			,UPDATED_BY
			,CREATED_DATE
			,UPDATED_DATE
			,FLAGS
			,BANK_SHORT_NM
			,IS_CC_ISSUER
			,BANK_BIC
			,PESONET
			,INSTAPAY
			,EWALLET
			,EWALLETSEQ
			,QR
			,P2M
			HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
		) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKBANKSTB]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKBANKSTB A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKBANKSTB_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
